dialogue.origin: こんばんは
dialogue.content: Good evening.

dialogue.origin: こんばんわ、よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.content: Good evening. Thank you for reaching out.

dialogue.origin: 本日はどのようなお話でいらっしゃいましたか？
dialogue.content: What brings you here today?

dialogue.origin: 宜しくお願いします
dialogue.content: Thank you for having me.

dialogue.origin: 自分に自信がなくなってしまって
dialogue.content: I've lost confidence in myself.

dialogue.origin: 人と会いたくないというか
dialogue.content: I guess you could say I don't want to see people.

dialogue.origin: 会社にも行きたくないんです
dialogue.content: I don't even want to go to work.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、、それはお困りですね。
dialogue.content: I see, that must be very troubling for you.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 何かきっかけとかございましたか？
dialogue.content: Was there something that triggered this?

dialogue.origin: この間、資格試験があったのですが
dialogue.content: Well, there was a certification exam recently.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 年下の人が合格したのに私は落ちてしまって
dialogue.content: Someone younger than me passed, but I failed.

dialogue.origin: そうだったんですね
dialogue.content: I see, so that's what happened.

dialogue.origin: しかも資格合格で彼女がチームリーダーと言うか、
dialogue.content: And because she passed the exam, she became the team leader, or rather...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 私の部署の上司みたいな立場になって、指示される側になってしまって
dialogue.content: She’s now in a position like my supervisor in our department, and I’ve ended up being the one taking instructions from her.

dialogue.origin: あら、、そうなんですね
dialogue.content: Oh, I see.

dialogue.origin: 毎日本当に嫌なんです
dialogue.content: I really hate it every single day.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、、
dialogue.content: I understand...

dialogue.origin: 失礼ですが、相談者さまの年代など教えていただけますか？
dialogue.content: Forgive me for asking, but could you tell me your age range?

dialogue.origin: 29才です
性別も教えて頂いてもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: May I also ask your gender?

dialogue.origin: 女性です
dialogue.content: I'm a woman.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。。
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: なんとお呼びすれば宜しいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: How would you like me to address you?

dialogue.origin: まきです
dialogue.content: You can call me Maki.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございますまきさんよろしくお願いします
dialogue.content: Thank you, Maki. It's nice to speak with you.

dialogue.origin: そうしますと、
dialogue.content: So then,

dialogue.origin: 宜しくお願いします
dialogue.content: Yes, thank you.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 先日の試験というのは昇格がかかった試験だったのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Was that recent exam tied to a promotion?

dialogue.origin: 昇格をはっきり言われたわけではないですが、資格が無いと昇格はできないという性格の資格ではありました
dialogue.content: I wasn't explicitly told it was for a promotion, but it was the kind of certification you need to get promoted.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、まきさんも狙われたわけですね
dialogue.content: I see, so you were aiming for that as well, Maki.

dialogue.origin: 結構自分ではよいところまでできたと思ったので、落ちたことは本当にショックで
dialogue.content: I thought I did quite well, so I was really shocked that I failed.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、、それは落ち込んでしまいますよね
dialogue.content: I understand... That would certainly be disheartening.

dialogue.origin: わたしも経験ございます、お気持ちお察しします。
dialogue.content: I've had a similar experience, so I can imagine how you feel.

dialogue.origin: どんな経験なんですか？
dialogue.content: What kind of experience was it?

dialogue.origin: 昇格試験に落ちた経験です；
dialogue.content: I failed a promotion exam once.

dialogue.origin: もう少し、
dialogue.content: If I may,

dialogue.origin: そうですか
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: お話おきかせいただきたいのですが、
dialogue.content: I'd like to hear a little more, if you don't mind.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: その年下の女性とまきさんとはどのようなご関係だったのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: What was your relationship with this younger woman like before?

dialogue.origin: 年齢違いだけど同期です
dialogue.content: We started at the company at the same time, though she's younger.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、、仲も良かったかんじですか？
dialogue.content: I see... Were you on good terms?

dialogue.origin: そうですね、うまく協力していました。彼女が上司に引き立てられて、
dialogue.content: Yes, we collaborated well. But she was favored by our boss, and...

dialogue.origin: にこにこ話していた李
dialogue.content: she would always be smiling and chatting with them...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: I understand.

dialogue.origin: 業務指示をする朝礼などあって
dialogue.content: and now we have morning meetings where she gives out work instructions.

dialogue.origin: すごく悔しいです
dialogue.content: It's so frustrating.

dialogue.origin: いや~な気分になります
dialogue.content: It puts me in a terrible mood.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、、悔しいお気持ちなんですね
dialogue.content: I see, so you're feeling frustrated.

dialogue.origin: どんな部分が特に嫌ですか？
dialogue.content: What part of it bothers you the most?

dialogue.origin: 実力もある人だから仕方ないですが、たぶん資格試験の成績もそんなに違わないと思うのに
dialogue.content: She's talented, so I know it can't be helped, but I don't think our exam scores were that different.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 周りからちやほやされて
dialogue.content: Everyone is fawning over her,

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes...

dialogue.origin: けど私は今まで通り、ルーティーンワークのまま
dialogue.content: while I'm still stuck doing the same old routine work.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、、
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: その年下の女性と比べてしまう感じでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Do you find yourself comparing yourself to this younger colleague?

dialogue.origin: 彼女も悪気はないかもしれないけど、にこにこ話しかけてきて
dialogue.content: She probably doesn't mean any harm, but she comes up to me, all smiles, and starts talking,

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 私に力が無いってことを
dialogue.content: and it makes me feel

dialogue.origin: つうかんします
dialogue.content: so painfully aware that I lack ability.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、、そこが一番気になる感じなのですね
dialogue.content: I see... so that's what is bothering you the most.

dialogue.origin: もし、、ですが、
dialogue.content: Hypothetically,

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: I understand.

dialogue.origin: まきさんも試験に合格してたらどうなってましたか？
dialogue.content: if you had passed the exam as well, Maki, what do you think would have happened?

dialogue.origin: 分かりませんが、同じ立場で違うグループに配属されたかも
dialogue.content: I'm not sure. Maybe I would have been assigned to a different group but in the same position.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、、
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: そうなってたら
dialogue.content: And if that had happened,

dialogue.origin: いまのような嫌な気持ちにはならずにいられましたか？
dialogue.content: do you think you would have been able to avoid feeling the way you do now?

dialogue.origin: でも現実に今は毎日彼女の指示で仕事して、
dialogue.content: But the reality is that I work under her instructions every day now,

dialogue.origin: 毎日嫌な気持ちになって
dialogue.content: and I feel awful every day.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 正直、彼女を褒めて持ち上げている同僚の顔を見るのも嫌な気持ちです
dialogue.content: Honestly, it's even unpleasant to see the faces of my colleagues praising and flattering her.

dialogue.origin: わたしができないのがわるいんですけど
dialogue.content: I know it's my fault for not being capable enough, but...

dialogue.origin: なるほど、今のグループは何名くらいいらっしゃるのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I see. About how many people are in your current group?

dialogue.origin: 8名です
dialogue.content: Eight people.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、、他の方々も嫌な思いされてる感じですか？
dialogue.content: I see. Does it seem like the others feel uncomfortable as well?

dialogue.origin: いえ、彼女を褒めたりしてます
dialogue.content: No, they praise her.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、、
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: よく出来る人なのは本当なので
dialogue.content: Because it's true that she's very capable.

dialogue.origin: まきさんのお悩みは、他の方に相談されたりしてますか？
dialogue.content: Have you talked to anyone else about your concerns, Maki?

dialogue.origin: かいしゃでですか？
dialogue.content: You mean, at work?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: みんなおめでとうムードなのに言えません
dialogue.content: Everyone is in a celebratory mood, so I can't say anything.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、、そういう感じなのですね。
dialogue.content: I see, so that's the atmosphere.

dialogue.origin: まきさんは、
dialogue.content: Maki,

dialogue.origin: それも、試験落ちたのに受かった彼女に悔しがるって
dialogue.content: Besides, being resentful toward the person who passed when I'm the one who failed...

dialogue.origin: みじめですよね
dialogue.content: it's pathetic, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: そんな相談したら
dialogue.content: If I were to talk to someone about that,

dialogue.origin: 彼女ができる人なのは私もそう思うし、
dialogue.content: and I agree that she's a capable person...

dialogue.origin: 相談というか、ざっくばらんにお話とかされる雰囲気ではない感じなのですね
dialogue.content: So it doesn't sound like the kind of atmosphere where you can talk openly about things.

dialogue.origin: まきさんは、、
dialogue.content: Maki...

dialogue.origin: 私が落ちたんだから昇格しないのも仕方ないと思うんです
dialogue.content: Since I failed, I think it’s only natural that I didn't get promoted.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、、
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: 試験はもう終わりなのですか？
dialogue.content: Is that exam over for the year?

dialogue.origin: だけど実際、業務指示とかされると嫌な気持ちになって
dialogue.content: But in reality, when I'm given work instructions from her, I feel awful,

dialogue.origin: ドロドロ抑えられない
dialogue.content: and I can't suppress these murky, negative feelings.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、、
dialogue.content: I understand.

dialogue.origin: 今年度は終わりです
dialogue.content: It's over for this fiscal year.

dialogue.origin: 業務j指示されると、どんなところが嫌な気持ちになりますか？
dialogue.content: When you're given work instructions, what about it makes you feel so upset?

dialogue.origin: 同期で年下なのにうまくいってる彼女がいやなんです
dialogue.content: It's that she's my peer, she's younger than me, and she's succeeding. I hate it.

dialogue.origin: きっと私の事をかわいそうって思ってる
dialogue.content: I'm sure she feels sorry for me.

dialogue.origin: そう言われたのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Has she said that to you?

dialogue.origin: そんなこと言う人じゃないですけど
dialogue.content: She's not the type of person to say something like that, but...

dialogue.origin: 年下だと、どんなところが気になりますか？
dialogue.content: What is it about her being younger that particularly bothers you?

dialogue.origin: 指示する時に妙に遠慮っぽく言ったりするし
dialogue.content: When she gives me instructions, she says them in this strangely hesitant way,

dialogue.origin: はい、気を使われる感じですか？
dialogue.content: Yes, so it feels like she's being overly careful around you?

dialogue.origin: 同期だから同じだけの経験でやってて年上だったらもっとできるのが当たり前っておもいませんか？
dialogue.content: We started at the same time, so we have the same amount of experience. Don't you think it's natural to expect the older person to be more capable?

dialogue.origin: 周りの人も
dialogue.content: The people around us too,

dialogue.origin: 彼女も
dialogue.content: and her as well.

dialogue.origin: 誰かにそう言われたことございますか？
dialogue.content: Has anyone actually said that to you?

dialogue.origin: ないです
dialogue.content: No.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、、
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: まきさん、、
dialogue.content: Maki...

dialogue.origin: 同期という事と、年下ということが
dialogue.content: The fact that she started at the same time as you and is younger,

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: I understand.

dialogue.origin: 一番気になる感じですか？
dialogue.content: is that what bothers you the most?

dialogue.origin: もし、、
dialogue.content: If...

dialogue.origin: 年上の人だったら気になりませんか？
dialogue.content: Would it bother you as much if she were older?

dialogue.origin: わからないです
dialogue.content: I don't know.

dialogue.origin: 実際毎日つらいのは彼女の事なんで
dialogue.content: The person making every day so painful is her.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Right.

dialogue.origin: そのお気持ちを解決できるとしたら、何か思い当たる方法とかございますか？
dialogue.content: If it were possible to resolve these feelings, can you think of any way to do that?

dialogue.origin: 仮にほかの人が受かっててという考えをしても意味が無いと思うんです
dialogue.content: I don't think there's any point in thinking about 'what if someone else had passed'.

dialogue.origin: そうですか
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 難しい問題ですね
dialogue.content: It’s a difficult situation.

dialogue.origin: 今年度は終わり、、来年度は再チャレンジできる感じですか？
dialogue.content: So it's over for this fiscal year... will you be able to try again next year?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes,

dialogue.origin: それまで一年間我慢するしかないってことですよね
dialogue.content: So that means I just have to endure it for a year until then, right?

dialogue.origin: 分かりました
dialogue.content: I understand.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: では、まずは次の試験に向けて頑張るのは一つですよね
dialogue.content: Well, working hard for the next exam is one thing you can do.

dialogue.origin: あとは、、それまでの問題は、
dialogue.content: And as for the problem in the meantime,

dialogue.origin: まきさんのお気持ちが軽くなれる方法を見つけたいのですが、
dialogue.content: I'd like to find a way to help you feel a little better.

dialogue.origin: どこまで我慢できるかですから、だめなら
dialogue.content: It's just a matter of how much more I can endure, so if I can't,

dialogue.origin: やめるしかないと思ってます
dialogue.content: I think I'll have no choice but to quit.

dialogue.origin: 自分の努力が足りなかったのだから、仕方ないです。
dialogue.content: It was my own fault for not trying hard enough, so it can't be helped.

dialogue.origin: そこまでお困りなのですね。どうなれば良いと思われますか？
dialogue.content: You're struggling that much. In an ideal world, what outcome would you want?

dialogue.origin: それは考えてもどうにもならないです。彼女が異動することは無いわけだし
dialogue.content: There's no point in thinking about it. It's not like she's going to be transferred,

dialogue.origin: 会社を辞めることまでお考えなようなので、
dialogue.content: Since you're even thinking of quitting your job,

dialogue.origin: 自分の実力もすぐに上げられるわけではないし、
dialogue.content: and it's not like I can improve my skills overnight,

dialogue.origin: 試験は一年後だし
dialogue.content: and the next exam is a year away.

dialogue.origin: このまま辞めるのはすごく悔しいんじゃないかと
dialogue.content: I would think that quitting like this would be incredibly frustrating,

dialogue.origin: 思いますが、
dialogue.content: don't you?

dialogue.origin: でも、先生も我慢するしかないっておっしゃるのだから
dialogue.content: But you yourself said that I have no choice but to endure it.

dialogue.origin: 辞める前に何か、少しでもご自分の気持ちを変えられることとか、
dialogue.content: I was thinking that before you quit, perhaps there's something we could do to help change how you feel, even just a little.

dialogue.origin: 大人の結論はそういうことで
dialogue.content: That's what an adult conclusion is,

dialogue.origin: と思いました。
dialogue.content: or so I thought.

dialogue.origin: 正しいんだなって思います
dialogue.content: I suppose you're right.

dialogue.origin: 気持ちをどうやって買えたらいいのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: How can I change the way I feel?

dialogue.origin: 変えたら
dialogue.content: If I can change them...

dialogue.origin: そうですね、、
dialogue.content: Let's see...

dialogue.origin: 少し、一歩引いてみて、状況を確認してみるのも一つですが・・・
dialogue.content: Well, one option is to take a step back and try to look at the situation a bit more objectively.

dialogue.origin: お話を伺ってて思うのですが、
dialogue.content: As I've been listening to you, it occurs to me that...

dialogue.origin: 一歩引くってどういうことですか？
dialogue.content: What do you mean by 'taking a step back'?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 誰かに何かを言われたことではなく、まきさんのお気持ちの仲の事が大半かと
dialogue.content: most of this seems to be about what's happening inside your own mind, rather than something someone has actually said to you.

dialogue.origin: 要は、状況の捉え方かと思いました。
dialogue.content: In other words, I think it's about how you're perceiving the situation.

dialogue.origin: なるほど
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: そうかもしれません
dialogue.content: That might be true.

dialogue.origin: まきさんは毎日凄く嫌な思いをされてる
dialogue.content: You're having a very difficult time every day.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Right.

dialogue.origin: でも、誰かにはっきり何かをいわれたわけではなく、
dialogue.content: But it's not because someone has explicitly said anything to you,

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: まきさんの心の中で、そう解釈されてしまっている・・・
dialogue.content: but rather that you are interpreting things that way in your own mind.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: もし、考え方を少し変えれたら、お気持ち少しラクになれるのかなーと思いました。
dialogue.content: I was thinking that if you could shift your perspective just a little, you might feel a bit more at ease.

dialogue.origin: なので、少し一歩引いてみて、とお話させて頂きました。
dialogue.content: That’s why I suggested taking a small step back.

dialogue.origin: どうやって変えるんですか？
dialogue.content: How do I change my perspective?

dialogue.origin: 一歩引くっていう意味が分かりません
dialogue.content: I still don't understand what 'taking a step back' means.

dialogue.origin: 一つは、
dialogue.content: One way is,

dialogue.origin: まきさんに、今思われてることが、
dialogue.content: for you to consider whether the things you're thinking right now

dialogue.origin: 事実なのか、想いなのか、、
dialogue.content: are facts or your own interpretations.

dialogue.origin: が重要と思います。
dialogue.content: I think that's an important distinction to make.

dialogue.origin: 事実じゃない部分なら、どうしてそう感じるのか、と深堀りしてみると何か見えてくること、感じることとかあるかもしれません。
dialogue.content: For the parts that aren't facts, digging deeper into why you feel that way might help you discover something new.

dialogue.origin: 一度試されてみてはいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Would you be willing to give that a try?

dialogue.origin: 見えてくる事って・・・対処法は自分で探すしかないってことですか？
dialogue.content: 'Discover something new'...? Does that mean I have to find a solution on my own?

dialogue.origin: いいえ、それも一つと思いました。
dialogue.content: No, that was just one suggestion.

dialogue.origin: 分かりました
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: または、ご友人にもご意見頂くとか、また宜しければ、こちらにいらっしゃて頂いて、その後の状況など、またお聞かせいただければと思います。
dialogue.content: Another option is to get a friend's opinion, or, if you'd like, you could come back here again and we could talk about how things are going.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: そうします
dialogue.content: I'll do that.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうご会いました
dialogue.content: Thank you for your time.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: また、並行し、来年度の試験合格に向けぜひ頑張って頂ければと思います。応援しております。
dialogue.content: At the same time, I hope you'll do your best to pass the exam next year. I'll be rooting for you.

dialogue.origin: 有難うございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: それでは失礼します。お疲れさまでした。
dialogue.content: Well then, I'll sign off now. Thank you for your hard work.

dialogue.origin: はい！勉強になりました、ありがとうございました！
dialogue.content: Yes! This has been very helpful. Thank you!

dialogue.origin: それでは、終了いたします。
dialogue.content: I will end the session now.

topic.sub: 年下の上司との関係とそれに伴うストレス
